edits.after: This does not mean a company must preserve every position forever. Organizations change and sometimes must end working relationships. Reciprocity means that even when making difficult decisions, the organization does not reduce people to numbers or use their past trust to deprive them of a fair chance to explain their side, the pay they are owed, or a dignified exit.
edits.reason: Root-confirmed interpretation: 公平说明资格 is the employee's fair chance to give their account, not merely an explanation supplied by the organization. Preserve nonpermanent roles, pay and dignified departure.
edits.before: This does not mean a company must preserve every position forever. Organizations change and sometimes must end working relationships. Reciprocity means that even in difficult decisions, people are not reduced to numbers, and past trust is not used to deprive them of a fair explanation, compensation owed, or a dignified departure.

edits.after: Eso no significa que la empresa deba conservar todos los puestos para siempre. Las organizaciones también cambian y a veces deben poner fin a relaciones laborales. La reciprocidad significa que, incluso al tomar decisiones difíciles, no se reduzca a la persona a una cifra ni se utilice su confianza pasada para privarla de una oportunidad justa de explicar su versión, de la remuneración que le corresponde o de una salida digna.
edits.reason: Root confirmed that the employee retains a fair chance to explain their side, rather than simply receiving an explicación justa from management. All other limitations retained.
edits.before: Eso no significa que la empresa deba conservar todos los puestos para siempre. Las organizaciones también cambian y a veces deben poner fin a relaciones laborales. La reciprocidad significa que, incluso al tomar decisiones difíciles, no se reduzca a la persona a una cifra ni se utilice su confianza pasada para privarla de una explicación justa, de la remuneración que le corresponde y de una salida digna.

edits.after: It feels more like stepping out of a shared world you once felt part of.
edits.reason: Naturalize belonging to a shared world without implying private ownership of it.
edits.before: It feels more like withdrawing from a shared world that once belonged to you.

edits.after: A person may have been sincerely committed and later changed direction. Past promises may have been fulfilled, and the sense of belonging may have been real. Choosing not to continue now does not prove it was all a performance.
edits.reason: Untangle the awkward tense sequence while retaining sincere past commitment, fulfilled promises and real belonging as possibilities, not universal findings.
edits.before: Someone can once have been sincerely committed and later change direction. Earlier promises may have been fulfilled, and earlier belonging may genuinely have existed. Not continuing now does not prove that everything before was a performance.

edits.after: A relationship that was limited from the start must leave both sides the possibility of ending it.
edits.reason: Render the originally limited nature of employment in ordinary prose; the following paragraph retains unequal power.
edits.before: Both sides must have the possibility of ending the relationship for it to retain its originally limited character.

edits.after: Sometimes acknowledging “I can no longer participate in the same way” is more responsible than pretending to belong when one has already pulled away.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'maintaining a belonging one has already withdrawn' without turning departure into betrayal.
edits.before: Sometimes acknowledging “I can no longer participate in the same way” is more responsible than maintaining a belonging one has already withdrawn.

edits.after: All this essay can establish is that leaving should not be classified in advance as betrayal. It is an action that calls for judgment, not one to condemn simply because it ends a relationship.
edits.reason: Avoid describing an action itself as automatically guilty; preserve the need to judge actual conduct and consequences.
edits.before: All this essay can establish is that leaving should not be classified in advance as betrayal. It is an action requiring judgment, not one automatically guilty because it ends a relationship.

edits.after: Cuando alguien sabe que no es la falta de alternativas lo que le hace quedarse, es más probable que entienda su permanencia como una elección renovada. La pertenencia es auténtica no porque la puerta esté cerrada con llave, sino porque la puerta existe y, aun así, uno desea volver.
edits.reason: Resolve the ambiguous negation of 'no continúa porque no tenga adónde ir'. The point is voluntary staying rather than staying for lack of alternatives.
edits.before: Cuando alguien sabe que no continúa porque no tenga adónde ir, es más probable que entienda su permanencia como una elección renovada. La pertenencia es auténtica no porque la puerta esté cerrada con llave, sino porque la puerta existe y, aun así, uno desea volver.

edits.after: When someone cannot meet the new demands, the story is no longer that the job has grown; it is that their performance has declined. Asking to discuss the change again is then treated as resistance to change.
edits.reason: Replace abstract 'an expansion of conditions' while retaining the organization's misleading attribution and the treatment of renewed discussion.
edits.before: Someone's inability to meet new demands is no longer described as an expansion of conditions, but as declining performance. Their request to discuss matters again is interpreted as resistance to change.

edits.after: The key question is not “Do I want this?” but “Is this still the kind of relationship I originally accepted? Have the new demands been explained, and am I being given the conditions I need to meet them?”
edits.reason: Naturalize the question about explanation and supporting conditions without making mere personal preference decisive.
edits.before: The central question is not “do I want to?” but “is this still the kind of relationship I originally accepted, and have the additions received the appropriate explanation and supporting conditions?”

edits.after: If power can expand without limit merely by preserving an exit people can scarcely afford, those who need work most will have the least protection for the limits of their original commitments.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'fewest boundaries around their promises'; preserve costly exit and unequal ability to maintain agreed limits.
edits.before: If power can expand without limit merely by preserving an extremely costly exit, those who need work most will have the fewest boundaries around their promises.

edits.after: This also reveals the distinction between trusting an organization and entrusting it with part of your future.
edits.reason: Root-confirmed interpretation: preserve the progressive distinction established in work01, not merely a shared limit on both forms of trust. Following paragraphs remain unchanged.
edits.before: This also marks a boundary concerning trust and what people entrust to an organization.

edits.after: Aquí también aparece la distinción entre confiar en una organización y poner parte del propio futuro en sus manos.
edits.reason: Root-confirmed reading of 信任与托付的分界: basic trust differs from entrusting future possibilities; do not collapse them into generic shared boundaries. Following paragraphs unchanged.
edits.before: Aquí también se traza un límite entre la confianza y lo que se confía a otros.

edits.after: An organization is not held together by everyone suffering the same amount.
edits.reason: The source concerns the basis of shared organization, not a literal moment when an organization comes into being.
edits.before: An organization does not come into being only when everyone suffers equally.

edits.after: It is more likely to hold together when people can see one another's different situations and are willing to redistribute the burden.
edits.reason: Carry the organizational-cohesion meaning naturally while retaining recognition of differences and redistributed burdens.
edits.before: It is more likely to come into being when members can recognize each other's differences and are willing to redistribute burdens.

edits.after: It also matters what, exactly, we keep doing.
edits.reason: Replace the philosophical calque 'persistence needs an object'; the next paragraph retains goal versus method and real difficulty versus understaffing examples.
edits.before: Persistence also needs an object.

edits.after: It is that, when someone has to stop, the others can still treat them as one of their own—not merely as one fewer pair of hands.
edits.reason: Preserve the final member-versus-usable-capacity contrast in idiomatic English rather than 'loss of usable strength'.
edits.before: It is that when someone must stop, the others can still treat them as one of their own, rather than merely as a loss of usable strength.

edits.after: Una organización no se sostiene porque todos soporten el mismo sufrimiento.
edits.reason: Make the source's collective-support meaning clear rather than suggest formal legal constitution.
edits.before: Una organización no se constituye únicamente cuando todos soportan el mismo sufrimiento.

edits.after: Es más probable que se sostenga cuando sus miembros pueden reconocer sus diferencias y están dispuestos a redistribuir las cargas.
edits.reason: Carry the reciprocal support meaning consistently with the preceding sentence.
edits.before: Es más probable que se constituya cuando sus miembros pueden reconocer sus diferencias y están dispuestos a redistribuir las cargas.

edits.after: También importa qué es exactamente lo que seguimos haciendo.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'la perseverancia necesita un objeto' while retaining the following inquiry into the object of persistence.
edits.before: La perseverancia también necesita un objeto.

edits.after: In fact, locked-in stability is often merely silence. People are still there, but they no longer offer their judgment, take initiative, or entrust part of their future to the organization. They do only what protects themselves while waiting for the moment when they can finally leave.
edits.reason: Preserve 托付 as entrusting future possibilities, not reduce it to generic trust. The future-part interpretation is explicit in this essay paragraph25 and consistent with work01.
edits.before: In fact, locked-in stability is often merely silence. People remain present but withdraw their judgment, initiative, and trust. They do only what protects themselves while waiting for the moment when they can finally leave.

edits.after: A way out can also mean changing roles.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'room to exit' while preserving the internal-change alternative; the following paragraphs retain limits and no guarantee of satisfying every wish.
edits.before: Room to exit also includes the ability to change roles.

edits.after: Leaving can carry costs. It must not mean writing someone off as a person.
edits.reason: Make 'the cost of negating a person' readable without deleting the subsequent recognition, pay and respect guarantees.
edits.before: Leaving can carry costs, but not the cost of negating a person.

edits.after: A door that really opens does not make the shared life inside meaningless.
edits.reason: Naturalize the real-exit door metaphor rather than the stiff 'a genuinely existing door'.
edits.before: A genuinely existing door does not make the shared life inside meaningless.

edits.after: It keeps the door in view and lets the way it treats people each day answer the question: why do they still choose to stay?
edits.reason: Untangle the closing sentence while retaining visible exit, daily treatment and staying as a continuing choice.
edits.before: It keeps the door visible, then answers why people still choose not to leave through the way it treats them every day.

edits.after: En realidad, la estabilidad bajo llave suele ser solo silencio. La persona sigue presente, pero retira su criterio, su iniciativa y su disposición a poner parte de su futuro en manos de la organización. Solo hace lo que puede protegerla, mientras espera el momento en que por fin pueda marcharse.
edits.reason: Preserve the deeper 托付 as entrusted future possibilities rather than collapse it into general confianza; paragraph25 makes this meaning explicit.
edits.before: En realidad, la estabilidad bajo llave suele ser solo silencio. La persona sigue presente, pero ha retirado su criterio, su iniciativa y la confianza que depositaba allí. Solo hace lo que puede protegerla, mientras espera el momento en que por fin pueda marcharse.

review_scope.reading_basis: Read every paragraph and title of the formal ZIP Chinese, English and Spanish manuscripts for work21–25 in bounded untruncated outputs. Total690 body-paragraph readings. No unread paragraphs. Intake helper checked alignment/Markdown correspondence.
review_scope.semantic_review: Full argument/example/qualification comparison. Preserved responsibility versus earned loyalty; reciprocal duties without permanent-job guarantees; departing responsibly rather than betrayal; reasonable adaptation versus material change; renewed consent and meaningful options; differences in endurance and genuine shared burdens; exit that can entail bounded costs but cannot erase protections. No paragraph compression or deleted examples.
review_scope.root_confirmed_interpretations: Essay21 paragraph29 is a fair opportunity for the employee to explain their side, not merely an explanation from management. Essay23 paragraph33 preserves the distinction between trusting the organization and entrusting future possibilities, as established in work01; following paragraphs unchanged. Essay25 paragraph23 also preserves the future-possibility sense explicit in its paragraph25. Both root queries resolved as translation interpretations, no Chinese source rewrite requested.
review_scope.metadata: Five English titles are unnumbered and polished where needed; Spanish23/24 titles polished. Remaining Spanish titles already natural and unnumbered.
review_scope.limits: Normative editorial/fidelity review, not exhaustive external legal, medical or empirical factchecking. No new external facts, translation service, supplied HTML execution, ZIP/repo changes, integration, visual QA, commit or publication.
